module: Utilities of the drag race editor: error display, unsaved changes flag, undo/redo stack on dragRaceData, validation and creation of default race/lane data, mouse update, creation of a transformUtil and ImGui header widgets.
notes: The undo stack is limited to state.getMaxUndoSteps() (20) entries; saveToUndoStack clears the redo stack.
updateMouseInfo here (unlike input.updateMouseInfo) assumes core_forest exists and forces down/hold/up to false if the raycast fails.
dragHeaderLabel returns two values (gsub also returns the number of replacements); only the first is used in the concatenation.
Validation requires a non-empty stripId or strip.lanes, plus a non-empty dragType.

logError.desc: Stores the message as the last error, displays it for 3 s and writes it to the log (level E, tag DragRaceEditor).

showError.desc: Displays the current error in red until its delay has elapsed; decrements the delay with the ImGui DeltaTime. To be called every frame.

markUnsavedChanges.desc: Marks the state as modified and unsaved.

saveToUndoStack.desc: Pushes a deep copy of dragRaceData (removes the oldest if the stack is full) and clears the redo stack.

undo.desc: Pops the previous state: the current one goes to the redo stack. Does nothing if the stack is empty.

redo.desc: Restores the undone state: the current one returns to the undo stack.

validateDragRaceData.desc: Checks that a dragRaceData is usable.

createNewLane.desc: Creates a default lane: names "Lane N", color blue, stage and endLine waypoints, boundary, all with the default transform.

createNewDragRaceData.desc: Creates a default dragRaceData: context activity, type headsUpRace, 4 phases (stage, countdown, race, stop), prefabs (christmasTree .500, displaySign, paths, decorations) unused.

reorderLanes.desc: Moves an element of an array from position old to new, shifting the others (modifies t in place).

updateMouseInfo.desc: Updates the state's mouse table (camera ray, raycast, left button click/hold/release if ImGui does not capture the mouse).

setupTransform.desc: Creates a transformUtil (gizmo) initialized from a transform table {position, rotation, scale}.

dragHeaderLabel.desc: ImGui-safe header text: "Untitled" if empty, otherwise the string without # characters.

dragSectionHeader.desc: Draws a CollapsingHeader with larger padding.

returns.desc: true if the section is open
